title: A locally Noetherian zero-dimensional scheme has discrete topology
statement: Let $Z$ be a locally Noetherian scheme [pqf-def-locnoeth] whose topological Krull dimension satisfies $\dim |Z|\leq0$ [def-kun-topological-krull-dimension]. Then the topology of $|Z|$ is discrete: every subset is open. No quasi-compactness or separation hypothesis is imposed; the empty scheme is included.
